DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。友人が拾い、私がここへ運びました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 拾得者と持参者を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My friend found it, and I brought it here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Distinguish the finder from the person bringing it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 実際の場所を見ましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Did you see the actual location?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いえ、駅前と聞きました。自分で見た場所とは言いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 場所は伝聞と示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: No, I was told it was outside the station. I will not say I saw the location myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the location is secondhand information. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 品をこちらへお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please hand the item over here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 開けずに持ってきました。中身は確認していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未開封で届ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I brought it unopened. I have not checked the contents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Hand it in unopened. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 拾った方へ連絡できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Can you contact the person who found it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。時刻と詳しい位置を本人に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人へ時刻位置を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will ask that person to confirm the time and exact location.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the time and location with the finder. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご自身の連絡先も伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will also ask for your contact details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 運んだ私の情報と、拾った友人の説明を分けて記録してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 連絡情報の出所を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please record my details as the person who brought it separately from my friend's account as the finder.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish the sources of contact information. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 品をお預かりします。拾った本人の確認事項と持参者の情報を区別して受付を進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will take the item. We will process the report while distinguishing what needs confirmation from the finder and the bringer's information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about the addressee?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 旧住所へ旧姓で届きました。今の私の名前と違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 旧姓旧住所の郵便を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: It arrived at my old address under my former surname. It differs from my current name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show mail with your old surname and address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is that your own former surname?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。前の住人ではなく私です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 旧姓が本人と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. It is me, not a previous resident.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the former surname belongs to you. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 旧新の情報を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check the old and new information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この資料です。封筒の名前を自分で書き換えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 資料を示し封筒を改変しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here are the documents. I will not rewrite the name on the envelope myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the documents without altering the envelope. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 差出人へ変更を伝えましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you told the sender about the changes?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 住所だけ伝えました。氏名の変更も別に連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 差出人へ氏名変更も伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I only told them my address. I will separately notify them of the name change too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Tell the sender about the name change too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: How is this mail currently being kept?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 未開封で私が持っています。転送手続きも今の情報で相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未開封と今後の手続きを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have it unopened. I would also like advice about forwarding procedures using my current information.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Discuss the unopened mail and future procedures. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 本人の旧姓宛て郵便として担当へ確認します。今回の郵便と今後の氏名住所変更を分けて扱います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will check with the staff as mail addressed to your own former surname. We will handle this mail separately from future name and address changes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you changing your contact details?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自分の携帯だけ変わりました。緊急連絡先は同じです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本人番号だけの変更を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Only my mobile number has changed. My emergency contact remains the same.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that only your own number is changing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 新しい番号をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please give us the new number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この番号です。家族の番号へ全部置き換えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 新番号と家族番号を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: This is the number. I am not replacing all the numbers with my family's number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the new number from the family number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 本人確認後に担当が進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The staff will proceed after verifying your identity.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 資料はこちらです。確認の電話が来る番号も聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 確認資料と返答先を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here are the documents. I also want to ask which number the verification call will come to.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Provide verification documents and ask where the response will go. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今回の変更欄を見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will look at the field being changed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 本人の欄だけですね。住所も同じです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 住所不変を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Only my own field, right? My address is unchanged too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that your address is unchanged. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 変更結果を確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can check the result of the change.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、緊急先を残した結果も見直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 緊急先保持の結果を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, I will also check that the emergency contact was retained.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check that the emergency contact was retained. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 本人番号のみの変更として確認します。住所と緊急連絡先は変更希望なしです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will confirm this as a change to your own number only. No address or emergency contact change is requested.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about the food?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 調理済みとありますが、食べる前に温める表示もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 調理済みと加熱案内を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: It says already cooked, but there are also instructions to heat it before eating.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Check the cooked label and heating instructions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 表示の手順を見ましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us look at the steps on the label.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: すぐ外で食べたいので、このまま食べる品か確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 屋外ですぐ食べる用途を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I want to eat it outside immediately, so I want to check if it can be eaten as it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to eat it outside immediately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらには加熱の案内があります。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 設備がないので、自分で不要と決めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 設備なしで手順を省かない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have no facilities, so I will not decide on my own that heating is unnecessary.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not skip the steps just because you lack equipment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: そのまま食べられる表示の物を比較したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 別商品を比較する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I want to compare products labelled ready to eat as they are.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Compare another product. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの商品の表示をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please look at this product's label.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 希望に合います。保存条件も見て、こちら一つにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 表示適合品を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: It meets my needs. I will check the storage conditions too and take one of these.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose a product matching the label requirements. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 元の商品は戻します。選んだ商品の食べ方と保存表示を残してお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will put the original product back. Keep the eating and storage instructions with the product you selected.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about the way back?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 休憩所に水筒を忘れました。駅へ行く前に戻りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 置き忘れへの戻り道を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I left my water bottle at the rest area. I want to go back before heading to the station.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask the way back for a forgotten item. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 入口から二つ目の屋根です。青い水筒です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 屋根の位置と特徴を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: The second roof from the entrance. It is a blue water bottle.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe the roof's position and the item. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can go back along this passage.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 帰りのバスまで二十分あります。近道で柵を越えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 残り時間と正規通路を使う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have twenty minutes before my return bus. I will not climb over the fence as a shortcut.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the remaining time and use the proper passage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 見つからなければ案内所へどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: If you cannot find it, come to the information desk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 名前は底にあります。ほかの青い水筒を取りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 私物を目印で照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: My name is on the bottom. I will not take another blue bottle.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Match your item using its identifying mark. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 駅で待っています。寄り道の時間を連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 同行者へ寄り道を連絡する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: They are waiting at the station. I will tell them how long the detour will take.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tell your companion about the detour. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: この通路で二つ目の屋根へ戻ってください。未発見なら底の目印を案内所へ伝えられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Return to the second roof along this passage. If it is not found, you can tell the information desk about the mark on the bottom.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 移動先はどちらですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: バス停です。雨で荷物が濡れるので屋根のある道を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 雨を避ける経路を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: The bus stop. My bags will get wet in the rain, so I want a covered route.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a route avoiding the rain. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 屋根は途中で切れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: There is a gap in the roof along the way.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 全部つながるとは思わず、傘を出す場所も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 屋根の切れ目を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will not assume it is covered throughout. Please also tell me where to get my umbrella out.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask where the roof ends. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 出口の手前に広い場所があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: There is a wide area before the exit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: そこで荷物を持ち直します。通路の真ん中では止まりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 通行外で荷物を整える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will adjust my bags there. I will not stop in the middle of the passage.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Arrange your bags outside the flow of traffic. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 歩く距離は少し長くなります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: The walking distance will be slightly longer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 近さより濡れにくさを選びます。バスは次の便でも構いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 距離より雨回避を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I prefer staying drier over a shorter route. Taking the next bus is fine too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose avoiding rain over a shorter distance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 入口へ戻る予定はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Do you plan to return to the entrance?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありません。バス停までの片道を案内してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 片道の行先を確定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: No. Please show me the one-way route to the bus stop.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm your one-way destination. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: この屋根の道で出口手前へどうぞ。そこで傘を準備し、横断案内からバス停へ進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Follow this covered path to before the exit. Prepare your umbrella there, then follow the crossing signs to the bus stop.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are asking about moving in, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 平日は寮、週末は家族の家です。住所の手続きを相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二住居の生活を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I live in the dormitory on weekdays and at my family's home on weekends. I want advice on address procedures.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Discuss living in two homes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 住み始めた時点を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell us when you started living there.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 寮は今月一日からです。家族の家はその前からです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 各開始時点を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: The dormitory since the first of this month. My family's home since before then.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the start date for each home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 生活の状況を担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: The staff will check your living arrangements.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 勤務先が寮へ送る郵便だけで、住所が決まるとは考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 郵送先だけで判断しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I do not assume my address is decided just by where my employer sends mail to the dormitory.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not judge by the mailing address alone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご家族も寮へ移りますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Will your family move to the dormitory too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: いえ、私だけです。家族の届出を一緒に変えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族は移らないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: No, only me. I am not changing my family's registration together with mine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that your family is not moving. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 寮の所在地は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Do you know the dormitory's address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この資料です。二つの生活場所と開始日を分けて説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 所在地と実態を整理する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: It is in this document. I will explain the two living locations and start dates separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Organize the addresses and living arrangements. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 二つの住居の実態の相談として担当へ引き継ぎます。記入する住所は案内後に確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will refer you to the staff to discuss the actual use of both homes. Check the address to enter after receiving guidance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 予約変更の理由を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: May I ask why you want to change your appointment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 薬が予約の前に足りなくなりそうです。早められるか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 薬不足で早い予約を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: My medicine may run out before the appointment. I want to ask if it can be brought forward.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for an earlier appointment because medicine may run out. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 残りの記録はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have a record of the remaining amount?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 袋と数えたメモです。自分で飲む量を減らして延ばしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 残数と指示未変更を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: The bag and a note of the count. I have not reduced the dose myself to make it last longer.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the remaining amount and explain that instructions were not changed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 薬の扱いは診療担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check with the clinical staff about the medicine.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 受診日の変更と薬の相談を二つとも伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 薬相談と日時変更を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please tell them both about changing the appointment date and my medicine concern.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish the medicine consultation and date change. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you have a preferred day?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 水曜なら来られます。元の予約は確認前に取り消しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 候補と既予約維持を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I can come on Wednesday. I will not cancel the existing appointment before confirmation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give a possible day and retain the existing booking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当から方法を案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: The staff will explain how to proceed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 残数と今の指示を見てもらい、予約結果も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 指示と結果の確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will have them check the remaining amount and current instructions, and also confirm the appointment result.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask to check the instructions and outcome. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 予約前の薬の不足懸念を担当へ引き継ぎます。服用や予約を自己変更せず案内を受けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will pass on your concern about running out before the appointment. Do not change doses or the booking yourself; follow the guidance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 自転車について伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: May I ask about the bicycle?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自分の自転車はここにありますが、隣の自転車と同じ錠でつながっていて出せません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 車体は存在するが別の錠で動かせないと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: My bicycle is here, but the same lock connects it to the bicycle beside it, so I cannot take it out.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that the bicycle is present but immobilized by another lock. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その錠はご自身の物ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 違います。誰が掛けたかは見ていません。隣の車体の持ち主が掛けたとも決めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 錠が自分の物でなく掛けた人物も未確認と示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. I did not see who put it on. I will not assume the owner of the neighboring bicycle did it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the lock is not yours and who attached it is unconfirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 自分の車体だと確認できる情報はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you have information confirming the bicycle is yours?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 登録番号の控えがあります。自分の車体を示せても、別の錠を外す権限まであるとは考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 車体の所有情報と錠を外す権限を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have a copy of the registration number. Even if I can identify my bicycle, I do not assume that gives me authority to remove another lock.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish ownership information from authority to remove the lock. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 現場の様子は記録されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you recorded the situation at the location?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 写真を撮りました。二台の位置と錠がどこを通っているかを残し、切ったり車体を引いたりしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 接続状態の写真と未切断未移動を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I took photos showing the two bicycles' positions and where the lock passes through. I have not cut it or pulled the bicycle.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain the connection photos and that you have neither cut nor moved it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 管理者にも連絡できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Can you also contact the manager?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。持ち主へ連絡できるか管理者へ尋ねます。自分の鍵だけでは解決しないので、動かせない状態を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 管理者への連絡と動かせない状態の相談を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will ask the manager if the owner can be contacted. My own key cannot solve it, so I want advice on the immobilized bicycle.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask for help contacting the manager and discussing the immobilized bicycle. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 車体の控えと現場の写真を確認します。管理者への連絡状況も伺い、別の錠が掛かっている状態について相談を受け付けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will check the registration copy and location photos. We will also ask about contact with the manager and take your report about the other lock.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自分宛ての封筒を一番外にしました。返信用だったようです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 返信用を外側にした誤りを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I put the envelope addressed to myself on the outside. It seems it was the return envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the mistake of using the return envelope outside. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 提出の案内を見せてください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらです。提出先へ送る封筒は別に必要ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 提出案内で役割を読む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here they are. I need a separate envelope addressed to the submission office, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Read the envelope roles in the instructions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 同封条件は提出先へ確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Check enclosure requirements with the submission office.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この返信用は中へ入れ、外の宛先は提出先で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 内外の宛先を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will put this return envelope inside and confirm the outer address with the submission office.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish the inner and outer addresses. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 返信用の切手の指定もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Are there stamp requirements for the return envelope too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: あります。外へ送る郵便料金と別に準備します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 返信切手と往路料金を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will prepare those separately from the outgoing postage.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish return stamps from outgoing postage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 書類は揃っていますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。二つの宛先と料金を見直してから封を閉じます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 両封筒を確認して封を閉じる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will review both addresses and postage before sealing the envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check both envelopes before sealing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 提出先宛ての外封筒が整ってから配送条件を相談してください。返信用は案内に合わせて同封します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Ask about shipping conditions once the outer envelope addressed to the submission office is ready. Enclose the return envelope according to the instructions.
